steps.say: Undescended testes are recorded as common at birth. Cryptorchidism is found in three percent of full term boys. Premature neonates are affected in up to thirty percent. Most testes are descended by three to six months. Spontaneous descent afterwards is staged as rare. Referral is booked for persistent cases.
steps.tx: **Cryptorchidism** (undescended testis) affects **3%** (three in a hundred) of full-term boys and up to **30%** (thirty in a hundred) of premature neonates, with **spontaneous descent** (natural dropping) rare after **3 to 6 months** (three to six months). Examine every newborn and recheck at scheduled visits. Refer persistent cases promptly, because timing decides fertility.

steps.say: Surgery is timed early to protect fertility. Orchidopexy is scheduled between six and twelve months of age. The operation is completed by eighteen months of age. Spermatogenesis with Leydig cells is preserved by early surgery. Waiting beyond infancy is staged harming germ cells. Anaesthetic planning is matched to the infant age.
steps.tx: **Orchidopexy timing** (fixation schedule) places definitive surgery between **6 and 12 months** (six to twelve months) and complete by **18 months** (eighteen months) to protect **germ cell preservation** (future fertility). Operate in infancy rather than waiting for late descent. Counsel parents on fertility and cancer watch, because early surgery serves both.

steps.say: Hidden testes are mapped using camera surgery always. Diagnostic laparoscopy is staged as the gold standard here. Non palpable gonads are located directly by camera. Blind ending vessels are staged proving vanished testes. Intra-abdominal testes are mobilized gently for descent. Open exploration is avoided as the first choice here.
steps.tx: **Diagnostic laparoscopy** (camera mapping) is the gold standard for **non-palpable testis** (hidden gonad), finding blind-ending vessels of a **vanishing testis** (withered remnant) or an intra-abdominal testis for mobilized descent. Avoid ultrasound chasing in expert hands. Proceed to definitive repair in the same sitting, because mapping and fixing combine well.

steps.say: High testes are managed needing vessel division here. Fowler Stephens orchiopexy is performed for intra-abdominal gonads. Testicular vessels are tied while collaterals are kept. The deferential artery is kept feeding the gonad afterwards. Cremasteric vessels are added as further supply. Single or two stage approaches are picked by length.
steps.tx: **Fowler-Stephens** (vessel dividing orchiopexy), single or two-stage, performs **testicular vessels ligation** (cord vessel tie) while sparing the **deferential artery collateral** (vasal lifeline) plus cremasteric supply. Choose two stages when length is short. Wrap the mobilized testis without tension, because stretched vessels thrombose.

steps.say: Undescended gonads are charged carrying cancer risk lifelong always. Four to eight fold risk is quoted for testicular malignancy. Seminoma is reported as the commonest type. Orchidopexy is staged enabling examination of the gonad routinely. Risk is never removed by surgery alone. Lifelong self examination is taught carefully afterwards.
steps.tx: **Malignancy risk cryptorchidism** (cancer danger) runs **4- to 8-fold** (four to eight times) for testicular cancer, most often **seminoma** (uniform germ tumour). Orchidopexy places the gonad where examination works but never erases risk. Teach lifelong self examination after surgery, because early lumps still cure.

steps.say: A hernia sac is staged riding with most undescended testes. Patent processus vaginalis is found in over ninety percent. The sac is dissected high at surgery. Ligation is staged closing the hernia defect firmly. Laparoscopy is staged handling the sac from inside. Open repair is staged tying it at the ring.
steps.tx: **Patent processus vaginalis** (open hernia channel) rides with over **90%** (ninety in a hundred) of cryptorchid testes, needing high dissection with **hernia sac ligation** (sac tie off) at orchidopexy. Close the defect firmly in open or laparoscopic repair. Check the other side, because bilateral patency is common.

steps.say: Both sides impalpable with normal penis is staged warning endocrine disease. Bilateral non palpable testes are staged as endocrine emergency. Congenital adrenal hyperplasia is ranked topping the list in such babies. Salt wasting crisis is staged threatening life within days. Karyotype with hCG stimulation testing is ordered at once. Steroids with salt rescue are started without delay.
steps.tx: **Bilateral non-palpable testes** (both gonads hidden) with normal male genitalia demand urgent **congenital adrenal hyperplasia** (salt wasting intersex emergency) workup for 46,XX disease with salt wasting crisis risk. Send karyotype with **hCG test** (hormone stimulation check) at once. Start steroids and salt rescue without waiting, because crisis kills quickly.

steps.say: Hormones are staged rarely moving testes down durably. hCG with GnRH agonists is tried in some centres still. Durable descent is staged staying under fifteen percent always. Germ cells are harmed by failed courses. Routine hormonal therapy is staged as not recommended. Surgery is staged remaining the standard pathway.
steps.tx: **Hormonal therapy cryptorchidism** (drug descent attempt) with hCG or GnRH agonists shows **low efficacy** (poor lasting result) under **15%** (fifteen in a hundred) durable descent with germ cell harm, so routine use is not recommended. Proceed to orchidopexy instead. Reserve hormones for selected retractile cases, because surgery cures reliably.
